item.title: I Wrote a Borrow Checker for a Tiny Subset of C++
item.description: I wanted to know what a borrow proof is actually worth, so I built a closed-world checker for a toy C++ dialect and turned the proofs into LLVM noalias. Terrible idea. Would do again.
